svg.title: Quicksort with the first line as the pivot: one partition, then every pass on input already in order

g.title: The first line, "to", is the pivot. Each of the other 7 is compared with it: 6 are smaller and gather on the left, 1 is not. Then the pivot swaps into place 6, its place in the sorted output for good.
In order already, pass 1: the pivot, "always", is the smallest line left. 7 comparisons find nothing smaller, so it stays where it is and 7 lines are left for the next pass: 7 comparisons in all.
g.text: input: the lines already in order

g.title: In order already, pass 7: the pivot, "to", is smaller than the one line after it, which is in order by itself. 28 comparisons in all: 7 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1, n(n-1)/2 for n = 8, where the lines as read took 21.
